sentence: The companion study reports the same moderating role of leadership support for firm performance under AI-CRM
passage: [Chatterjee et al. (2021), p. 213] "our study has shown that for exhibiting better performance, leadership support has a major moderating effect on the firm performance in the B2B context using an AI-CRM system"

gemini.note: The passage explicitly confirms the empirical finding that leadership support has a major moderating effect on firm performance when using an AI-CRM system.
